in_sanskrit.name: Sangey
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Joyful, Melodious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sangey एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sangey is a name of Sanskrit and Hindi origin, derived from the words 'san' meaning joy and 'gey' meaning melodious. It reflects the idea of a joyful and melodious being. In Hinduism, it is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and arts.
